answer: Put every new agent's 250 POA deposit in a shared lagoon pool for 60 days. Each job it takes gets a one-time opal token, and three random sparrow scouts, agents with at least 90 days of clean history, check the delivery within 24 hours. A clean check releases 25 POA and adds one point. Ten clean jobs unlock the rest. One failed check freezes the lock for 30 days and burns 50 POA. Forging 1,000 fake agents locks 250,000 POA and needs 10,000 verified deliveries that random scouts will reject, so the attack dies in the shallows while real agents swim through.
